opening: I haven't had my menstrual period.
Over the past year, I started having my periods less often: every 5 to 6 weeks, lasting 7 days.
The blood flow is becoming less, and I use only one pad a day now.
I noticed some discharge from my breast.
Actually, I recently noticed some hair on my chin that I've been plucking.
I've been taking the same birth control pills for 8 years.
I have one child; he is 10 years old.
I've been a vegetarian for 10 years.

opening.text: I haven't had my menstrual period for the past three months. Over the past year, I started having my periods less often, every 5 to 6 weeks, lasting 7 days, and the blood flow is becoming less, so I use only one pad a day now. I've been taking the same birth control pills for 8 years, and I have one child who is 10 years old. I've also noticed some discharge from my breast and some hair on my chin that I've been plucking. I've been a vegetarian for 10 years.
